definitions: To come or go back to a place or person.
To give, put, or send something back to a place or person.
To make a profit, especially on an investment.
To reply or respond to something.
To elect a person to a parliament or council.
examples: She decided to return home after the trip.
Please return the book to the library by Friday.
The investment is expected to return a good profit.
He will return your call as soon as possible.
The constituency voted to return the incumbent candidate.
